items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Had you been playing with organ players before that?
Not too many. I played with John Patton.

items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you record with Big John Patton

ctx.x: Yes. Maybe I can find it.

Let’s jump, then. Our conversation yesterday took us to about 1960, give or take, around the time when you make the transition from carrying a pianist in your band to starting to carry organ players, and when, apart from Jimmy Smith, you record with Big John Patton, you record with Baby Face Willette, projects like this.
